title: Chemical Reactions: Types, Rates, and Equilibrium

questions.question: Heating limestone (CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂) is which type of reaction?
questions.rationale: One reactant splits into two products on heating — thermal decomposition.

questions.question: Iron displaces copper from copper sulfate solution because:
options: iron lies above copper in the reactivity series
iron melts at a lower temperature
questions.rationale: A more reactive metal displaces a less reactive one from its salt solution: Fe + CuSO₄ → FeSO₄ + Cu.

questions.question: In Na₂SO₄ + BaCl₂ → BaSO₄↓ + 2NaCl, the insoluble BaSO₄ is called a:
questions.rationale: This double-displacement swap partners in solution to form an insoluble solid — a precipitate, marked with the down-arrow.

questions.question: 'OIL RIG' reminds you that oxidation is ______ and reduction is ______.
options: gain of electrons; loss of electrons
loss of electrons; gain of electrons
loss of oxygen; gain of oxygen
gain of protons; loss of protons
questions.rationale: Oxidation Is Loss (of electrons), Reduction Is Gain — the electron bookkeeping behind every redox reaction.

questions.question: Which coefficients correctly balance CH₄ + O₂ → CO₂ + H₂O?
Respiration and photosynthesis differ because:
options: respiration is exothermic while photosynthesis is endothermic
respiration is endothermic while photosynthesis is exothermic
questions.rationale: Respiration releases the energy stored in glucose; photosynthesis absorbs sunlight to build glucose.

questions.question: Chemically, rust is:
questions.rationale: Rust is hydrated iron(III) oxide, Fe₂O₃·xH₂O — the flaky reddish-brown corrosion product.

questions.question: In the Haber process, N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ (ΔH = −92 kJ), raising the pressure shifts the equilibrium:
options: nowhere — it only speeds the reaction
questions.rationale: Pressure pushes the system toward fewer gas molecules — 4 mol of reactant become 2 mol of product — favouring ammonia.

questions.question: Adding a catalyst to a system already at equilibrium:
options: brings equilibrium sooner without shifting its position
questions.rationale: Catalysts lower the activation energy of both directions equally, so the mixture reaches equilibrium faster but its composition is unchanged.

questions.question: Chip packets are flushed with nitrogen mainly to:
options: prevent rancidity by keeping oxygen away from the fats
questions.rationale: Oxygen oxidizes fats and oils, turning them rancid; nitrogen is an inert blanket, and antioxidants help too.
